He challenged allegations regarding voter deletion and past election irregularities linked to the party’s leadership. Nabin emphasized the need for governance based on the Constitution rather than dynastic politics.

title: In a big blow to AAP, 2 MLAs quit party after 1st candidate list announcement
content: Chetan Singh Jouramajra from Samana and Harmeet Singh Pathanmajra from Sanour resigned from AAP recently. Their resignations occurred shortly after AAP announced its candidate list for 2027 assembly elections. Pathanmajra has faced legal issues, including a rape case, which has impacted his political standing. The party has appointed Surjit Singh Rakhra as constituency in-charge for Samana amid these developments.

title: Jeff Bezos’ ex-wife’s $30M gift to Silicon Valley nonprofit gets 10-year plan -- 77
content: MacKenzie Scott's $30 million donation to Housing Trust Silicon Valley supports a comprehensive 10-year housing plan. The plan aims to create lasting housing solutions across the Bay Area while expanding affordable housing initiatives. Housing Trust Silicon Valley will enhance first-time homebuyer programs and strengthen policy advocacy efforts from 2026 onward. This decade-long strategy will help ensure the donation generates ongoing impact in the community.

title: FREYJA missile shield: Ukraine's new bet against Russian ballistic missiles
content: Ukraine has finalized its contribution to the multinational missile defence system FREYJA, designed for intercepting ballistic missiles. The programme relies on European partners for essential technologies necessary for testing. Initial testing is targeted for late 2026, with battlefield deployment anticipated in 2027. As Russia increases missile and drone attacks, Ukraine seeks to develop an indigenous defence capability.

title: Texas school to be named after janitor who served children for 39 years
content: Marilyn Hampton, 76, who worked as a school custodian in Texas for 39 years, has been honoured with an elementary school named after her. Hampton, who once considered herself a failure for not attending college, regularly helped students with schoolwork and bought supplies for those in need. The surprise announcement on October 21 left her in tears. The school will open in August 2027.

title: FPIs withdraw Rs 34,843 crore from Indian stocks; second straight month of selling spree
content: Foreign portfolio investors withdrew Rs 34,843 crore from Indian equities in October, continuing a trend. Despite substantial outflows, foreign investors became net buyers towards the end of the month. Market experts suggest that recent foreign buying may indicate a shift in sentiment. Investors are focused on global crude prices and US interest rates influencing markets. The outcome of upcoming events will remain critical for future investment flows.

title: 'India not a banana republic': BJP attacks Rahul Gandhi ahead of INDIA bloc rally
content: Union minister JP Nadda accused Congress and Rahul Gandhi of attempting to destabilize the government and create unrest. Nadda labeled the opposition's rally at Ramlila Maidan as a calculated conspiracy against democracy and the economy. He outlined a model of politics involving misinformation and provoking protests. The INDIA bloc, however, claims to mobilize for democratic rights concerning alleged electoral roll irregularities.

title: Ohio couple's house sale deal upheld after split; woman gets $41,466
content: An Ohio man who refused to share money from his house sale with his former partner has lost a court battle. The couple had signed an agreement in 2021 to divide the proceeds if the property was sold. After their breakup, the man argued that the woman had not spent enough on renovations. However, an appeals court upheld the agreement, awarding her $41,466.50.

title: Irrfan made son Babil take buses and rickshaws to school despite owning cars
content: Babil Khan reminisces about his school days, often taking public transport despite his family's access to cars. His father, the late Irrfan Khan, believed in the importance of experiencing life's challenges, while his mother, Sutapa, was a constant supporter during significant moments, balancing her presence with Irrfan's film commitments. Babil cherishes the lessons and love from both parents that shaped his journey.

title: US senators write to Google CEO Sundar Pichai with 9 questions on classroom AI push
content: Two US senators have requested answers from Google CEO Sundar Pichai about the effects of AI tools on children. They highlighted concerns regarding the integration of AI products in schools and their potential negative impacts. The senators have set a deadline for a response by November 2, 2026. They specifically seek information on research conducted about AI's impact on children’s mental health.

title: Psychology says preferring candid photos may be more than an aesthetic choice
content: Candid photographs are often appreciated for their authenticity, standing in stark contrast to staged images that may feel contrived. Studies show that viewers often connect more deeply with the realness of candid shots, which encapsulate unguarded moments from daily life. This bias toward candidness does not necessarily correlate with a person's character or self-image.

title: Watch: Chaos at Bengaluru airport as flyer finds chicken in veg biriyani
content: Piyush Agarwal, a vegetarian flyer, discovered meat in a biryani at Taste of India restaurant. The incident occurred at Kempegowda International Airport, causing significant distress to his family. Agarwal stated that even his children unknowingly consumed the non-vegetarian food served to them. He requested an investigation by the relevant authorities regarding the matter. Airport officials acknowledged the incident and are currently conducting an internal review to understand the situation.

title: Pune woman secretly returned from UK; what she told domestic help before her death
content: Mugdha Deshmukh was found dead in her rented apartment in Pune after missing communication with her family. She had returned from the UK without informing them and rarely interacted with neighbors. Concerns arose when her family noticed recent food delivery transactions linked to her location. Police traced her to the Lodha Belmondo complex in Gahunje and gained entry to discover her body.

title: 110 years after Tennessee river was straightened, 985 acres to be restored
content: Authorities in Tennessee, US, have acquired 985 acres along the South Fork of the Forked Deer River to reduce flooding and restore natural habitats. The river was straightened in 1916 to drain surrounding land, but the changes contributed to flash floods and erosion. The restoration project aims to reconnect the river with its floodplain and eventually open the area to the public.

title: China fossil may reveal first amphibian to live entirely at sea 237m years ago
content: A recent discovery of the fossil Gerrothorax maritimus reveals that some ancient amphibians lived completely in marine environments. Dated to approximately 237 million years ago, this species had a flattened body covered in bony armour. The fossils were found in deep-sea sediments, indicating they lived far from landmasses. Geochemical tests confirmed the strontium isotopes matched those in seawater during the Late Triassic period.

title: Sells peanuts till 3 am, in class by 7:30: Student funds his own degree
content: Meet Ariston Era III, a resilient third-year Marine Engineering student who turns to peanut sales to fund his education and family needs. Juggling classes and late-night work, he is inspired by his mother’s values of hard work. With plans to launch a local delivery service and dreams of entering real estate, he remains focused on personal growth, navigating financial obstacles with determination.

title: 'All qualities of leader': Yuvraj backs Abhishek for India captaincy, inclusion in ODIs

title: GST collections rise 22.9% to Rs 2.31 lakh crore in October
content: October witnessed a remarkable surge in India's Goods and Services Tax revenues, hitting Rs 2.31 lakh crore, reflecting a commendable 22.9% growth from last year. This rise was primarily fueled by a staggering 42.2% increase in imports and consistent domestic transactions. Furthermore, major states contributed positively to these collections, showcasing a resilient economy and improved adherence to tax regulations across the country.

The wrestler from Jind, Haryana, had just become the first Indian woman to win a gold medal at the World Championships. Perhaps there is something special about this town - Jind. Manisha is not the only athlete from Jind to make the country proud this year.

title: Odisha Class 10 girl beats 33 rivals, wins Rs 48,000 at science seminar
content: Soumyashree Thanapati, a brilliant Class 10 student from Odisha, shined at the National Science Seminar 2026 in New Delhi. Showcasing her groundbreaking ideas on India's energy future, she triumphed over peers nationwide, winning first place and a scholarship of Rs 48,000. This remarkable victory marks Odisha's return to the forefront of this competition after 13 long years, highlighting the importance of innovative thinking in sustainable energy solutions.

title: Texas emu, chicken owner sparks land feud; Supreme Court blocks inspection
content: In a significant ruling, the Texas Supreme Court has sided with Pamela Bosco, affirming her right to keep her 14-acre homestead intact. The court denied neighbors’ requests for property inspections due to insufficient evidence of alleged violations. This ruling underscores the importance of legal processes in property disputes and confirms that establishing wrongdoing necessitates proper evidence gathering.

title: ECINET logins disabled in UP after Pilibhit row

He ordered the deactivation of login IDs used by voter registration centre operators. Following an inquiry, an outsourced computer assistant was terminated for their alleged involvement. District election officers have been instructed to verify the deactivation of these IDs promptly. The CEO emphasized the importance of maintaining the integrity of electoral roll management.

title: Skin woes, nightly meds: Bittu Tabahi pays the price for his lonely crusade

Despite worries expressed by his family regarding his well-being, Bittu's passion for preserving the river remains strong. He has implemented trash bins to combat littering, but the challenge persists.

A probe is underway to investigate the defiance of these safety orders prior to the crash. Search teams have resumed their operations to recover the bodies from the difficult terrain.

title: Vehicle curbs, WFH and more: From today, Delhi goes into full pollution patrol mode
content: Starting from November 1, the Delhi government will implement strict pollution control measures lasting until January 31. These initiatives will encompass vehicle-entry limitations, reduced office attendance, and increased parking fees. To mitigate dust emissions, outdoor construction will face grave restrictions during winter. Residents and vehicle owners are urged to comply to enhance city air quality. Furthermore, traffic patterns will be adjusted to reroute through-traffic away from Delhi.

title: NASA images show Antarctic island looking like giant skull after warm winter
content: NASA has unveiled satellite photos of Vega Island that strikingly resemble a skull, revealing alarming effects of climate change after an unusually warm winter. These images showcase substantial areas of bare ice exposed to seasonal warmth, raising concerns among scientists. Glaciologists, who have tracked the glaciers for decades, warn that this could accelerate melting during the summer, illustrating how global warming is reshaping Antarctica's landscapes.

title: Delhi-Agra in 59 mins: PM approves bullet train to link North India hubs

title: Kintsugi: Why Japanese art mends broken pottery with gold, not hiding cracks
content: Kintsugi is a beautiful Japanese tradition that honors broken pottery not by hiding imperfections but by accentuating them with lacquer and gold. This artistic approach signifies a celebration of each object's journey, revealing its story. Mirroring the wabi-sabi philosophy, Kintsugi has found modern relevance in sustainability, promoting the idea of repairing rather than discarding.

title: 'Cutting 130m voters unacceptable': Shashi Tharoor targets EC amid INDIA bloc's rally
content: Congress MP Shashi Tharoor accused the election commission of depriving voters of their constitutional rights . he said the campaign's message is “Vote Bachao, Desh Bachaao” as several inDIA bloc leaders move towards Ramlila Maidan for the mega rally .

title: Iran's Araghchi offers to reopen Strait of Hormuz in 2 days if US meets its demands
content: reopening of the Strait of Hormuz has been linked to a series of demands from the united states . foreign minister abbas araghchi proposes a two-day timeline for restoring access to the strategic waterway as diplomatic talks continue . the proposal is conditional on Washington meeting Tehran's demands .

title: Watch: NASA’s pencil-thin X-59 supersonic jet spotted flying across US skies
content: X-59 jet began cross-country journey from California to Florida . videos of the unusual-looking jet have since surfaced on social media . it comes as the space agency marks a year of flight testing for the experimental aircraft .

title: Meira Kumar declares CEC Gyanesh Kumar ‘unfit’ from chair once used by Nehru
content: ex-LS Speaker Meira Kumar presided over the inDIA bloc's symbolic “public impeachment” of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar . the chair was once used by the first prime minister of india, Jawaharlal Nehru .

title: 'GenZ regelt!' Thousands protest across Germany in Halloween costumes
content: protests in 34 cities turned violent in the evening, with rioters looting shops and clashing with police . violence broke out in major cities including Frankfurt, Berlin, Cologne and Hamburg . the protests were organised by the youth campaign group "Gen Z regelt!"

title: ‘Don’t just protest, shop’: Rahul urges INDIA bloc rally to support Delhi traders
content: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi urges protesters to shop from their stores during the festive season . he appealed to people travelling to Delhi from different parts of the country to support small businesses by purchasing goods after attending the rally . his appeal came after traders’ associations warned the gathering could disrupt business in the capital’s key commercial markets .

title: From asses to masses, Republicans wonder if Trump can still deliver wins
content: president Donald Trump has spent an extraordinary amount of campaign time discussing the physique of other public figures . he is now approaching it with the enthusiasm of a man who has just been informed that his prison sentence has been extended . "my voice is operating at about 49.2%," he grumbles at a rally in Florida on friday .

title: Science of a city: The maths, physics, ecology & psychology of urban life
content: a city is more than an assembly of buildings, roads and people . it is a complex system in which mathematics, physics, ecology and human behaviour constantly interact . if we are looking at cities through too narrow a lens, it might tell us something that conventional measures of development often miss .

title: Dog stranded for 20 days between cliff and raging river rescued in Nepal
content: seti was trapped on a narrow stretch of land, with a sheer cliff on one side and an overflowing channel of the river on the other . two kayakers braved rain and strong currents to bring the animal to safety . the rescue followed a three-day effort involving local authorities, animal welfare groups and residents to airlift the animal .

title: 3 Kukis killed in Naga gunfight; Imphal rally seeks NRC, dy CM's removal
content: three Kuki-Zo persons killed in gunfight with Naga groups in manipur . thousands rally in Imphal against alleged militant activities . the killings were reported near Tajeikaiphun village in the Rongmei Naga-majority hill district .

title: Char Dham chopper operators threaten to suspend flights over twin-pilot rule
content: a chopper crashing soon after take off from Badrinath on friday killed six people . the DGCA has made it mandatory for choppers operating on Char Dham to be manned by two pilots starting Monday (Nov 2) . a pilot and five passengers were killed in the crash .

title: 'BJP has forcibly shut down every shop': Rahul's big claim en route to Ramlila Maidan
content: Congress leader accuses BJP of causing financial losses to local traders . the leader of the opposition says the closures hurt businesses . he says participants travelling to the capital had been encouraged to shop at local markets . but he claims they found shops closed upon reaching Connaught Place .
